key_insights: Customers frequently report sanitizer stations are insufficient or congested, creating hygiene concerns during peak times.
recommendation: Increase number and strategic placement of sanitizer dispensers, enforce scheduled refills, and monitor high-traffic areas to prevent shortages.
justification: Directly addressing sanitizer availability reduces perceived health risk and improves member confidence during busy periods.

key_insights: Customers frequently report crowded showers causing long waits and negative locker-room experiences.
recommendation: Monitor peak shower usage to adjust staffing and cleaning schedules, add capacity or implement a simple time-slot/queue system to reduce congestion.
justification: Reducing shower crowding and wait times improves member satisfaction and throughput during peak hours.

key_insights: Customers frequently report that the air conditioning/temperature control could be improved, leading to discomfort.
recommendation: Service and recalibrate HVAC systems, add zoning or supplementary fans where needed, and set clear temperature targets with regular monitoring.
justification: Improved climate control directly reduces discomfort complaints and maintains a consistent workout environment.

key_insights: Customers frequently report staff performance issues during busy periods, citing poor responsiveness or crowd management.
recommendation: Provide targeted training on peak-time operations, increase floor staffing during known busy windows, and set measurable response-time targets.
justification: Better-trained and appropriately scheduled staff will improve service responsiveness and crowd handling when demand is highest.

key_insights: Customers frequently report treadmill performance issues indicating gaps in maintenance or equipment reliability.
recommendation: Establish a preventive maintenance schedule with faster turnaround for repairs and clear labeling for out-of-service machines.
justification: Proactive maintenance and clear communication reduce downtime, improve safety, and increase member trust in equipment availability.
